IDT12420.name: Derwent Estuary
IDT12420.text:
Friday 27 November
Winds: East to northeasterly below 10 knots tending east to southeasterly 10 to 15 knots in the middle of the day then becoming south to southeasterly about 10 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 80% chance of showers in the evening.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: East to northeasterly about 10 knots increasing to 10 to 15 knots in the early morning then shifting southwesterly in the early afternoon.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. Near 100% chance of rain.

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Westerly 10 to 15 knots.
Seas: Below 1 metre.
Weather: Cloudy. 80% chance of showers.

Monday 30 November
Winds: Westerly 15 to 25 knots decreasing to about 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 60% chance of showers.
IDT12420.synoptic: A high to the east of Tasmania is expected to slowly move eastwards over the next few days, maintaining a weak ridge over the state. A trough over Victoria and South Australia will then extend to the northwest of Tasmania today, directing an exceptionally moist northeasterly airstream over the state later today and early Saturday. A low centre is expected to develop on the trough early Saturday then cross Tasmania during the day, bringing widespread rain to much of the state. A cold front is expected to cross the state during Sunday with a cooler west to southwesterly airstream to follow which persists throughout Monday.

IDT12326.name: South East Coast
IDT12326.text:
Friday 27 November
Winds: Northerly 10 to 15 knots turning northeasterly 15 to 20 knots in the early afternoon.
Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres near Tasman Island during the afternoon.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Partly cloudy. 50% chance of showers at night.

Saturday 28 November
Winds: Northeasterly 20 to 30 knots shifting southwesterly 25 to 30 knots in the late afternoon.
Seas: 1 to 1.5 metres, increasing to 1.5 to 2.5 metres during the morning.
Swell: Northeasterly around 1 metre, increasing to 2 to 3 metres during the morning.
Swell: Southwesterly 1.5 to 2.5 metres.
Weather: Cloudy. Near 100% chance of rain.

Sunday 29 November
Winds: Southwesterly 25 to 30 knots turning westerly 20 to 30 knots during the morning.
Seas: 2 to 3 metres.
Swell: Southwesterly 2 to 3 metres inshore, increasing to 2 to 4 metres offshore.
Swell: Northeasterly 1.5 to 2 metres, decreasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the morning.
Weather: Cloudy. 95% chance of showers, with possible small hail in the evening.
